DC - M.Tech
Department Vision and Mission
To produce globally competitive engineering graduates with social awareness and become centre of excellence through research in the areas of Electronics & Communication Engineering.
To impart quality education to the students through quality faculty in the domain of Electronics & Communication Engineering and related fields to make them globally competitive in employment and higher education.
To pursue research in Electronics & Communication Engineering and related disciplines in order to serve the needs of the society.
Develop self-learning abilities and professional ethics to remain professionally competent so as to serve the society.
Department of DC
The Department of
Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE)
combines the study of electronics with modern communication systems to equip students with the knowledge and skills necessary to design, develop, and manage advanced electronic and communication technologies.
This field covers essential areas like:
Electronics:
Focusing on the design and functioning of electronic devices and circuits, including analog and digital systems, semiconductors, transistors, microprocessors, and microcontrollers.
Communication Systems:
Emphasizing the principles of data transmission and communication networks, with topics such as wireless communication, satellite systems, fiber optics, and network protocols.
Signal Processing:
Teaching students to analyze and interpret various types of signals (e.g., audio, video, digital data) for applications like image processing, audio enhancement, and speech recognition.
The ECE department aims to prepare students for careers in rapidly evolving technology fields, from telecommunications and broadcasting to embedded systems and IoT (Internet of Things).
